# DALL·E Commands for Witches and Wizards Artwork

This file contains ready-to-use `/dalle` commands for the macOS ChatGPT app to generate all artwork assets for the Witches and Wizards game.

## Quick Reference
- **Total Commands**: 317
- **Location Backgrounds**: 5 commands
- **Character Headshots**: 12 commands  
- **Full-Body Characters**: 300 commands (60 per location)
- **Style**: Josh Kirby cartoon style with transparent backgrounds

## Usage Instructions
1. Copy any command below
2. Paste into ChatGPT macOS app
3. The `/dalle` command will automatically generate the image
4. Save with the suggested filename for organization

---

## LOCATION BACKGROUNDS (5 commands)

```
/dalle Cartoon illustration in the style of Josh Kirby. A Cave. Clear bold outlines, vibrant colors, whimsical fantasy style. PNG format with transparent background. Viewed from the outside. Filename Cave.png
```

```
/dalle Cartoon illustration in the style of Josh Kirby. A Cottage. Clear bold outlines, vibrant colors, whimsical fantasy style. PNG format with transparent background. Viewed from the outside. Filename Cottage.png
```

```
/dalle Cartoon illustration in the style of Josh Kirby. A Castle. Clear bold outlines, vibrant colors, whimsical fantasy style. PNG format with transparent background. Viewed from the outside. Filename Castle.png
```

```
/dalle Cartoon illustration in the style of Josh Kirby. A Crypt. Clear bold outlines, vibrant colors, whimsical fantasy style. PNG format with transparent background. Viewed from the outside. Filename Crypt.png
```

```
/dalle Cartoon illustration in the style of Josh Kirby. A Caravan. Clear bold outlines, vibrant colors, whimsical fantasy style. PNG format with transparent background. Viewed from the outside. Filename Caravan.png
```

## MacOS ChatGPT App Tips

1. **Copy & Paste**: Simply copy any command above and paste into ChatGPT
2. **File Organization**: Use the suggested filenames to keep assets organized
3. **Batch Generation**: Generate 5-10 images at a time for efficiency
4. **Quality Check**: If style doesn't match, try adding "Josh Kirby style" emphasis
5. **Transparent Backgrounds**: DALL·E will attempt transparent backgrounds but may need manual removal
6. **Consistency**: Use same seed if available for character consistency across poses

```
Witches-and-Wizards-Assets/
├── Locations/
```
